feedback: The candidate matches the published DoorKey reward machine structure and satisfies every domain check. (1) FINAL_STATES: u3 is nonempty, declared in STATES, and is reached only via (u2, at_goal), which fires on the final goal step, so acceptance coincides exactly with task success; no non-goal trace can reach u3. (2) Semantic fidelity: the ordered progression u0 (no key) -> u1 (has key, door closed) -> u2 (door open) -> u3 (goal) mirrors the enforced constraints (has_key before door_open before at_goal), so every goal-reaching trace drives the machine to u3. (3) Persistent/event distinction: key_lost is correctly treated as a one-step event and used only from the has-key state, resetting to u0 with an explicit -0.2 regression penalty; u0 is the semantically exact reset target (no key, door closed), and the drop/re-pick cycle nets -0.1 so it cannot be farmed. Dropping the key after the door is open correctly does not trigger key_lost and leaves the machine in u2. (4) Ordered transition coverage: every state has an else self-loop covering irrelevant or non-listed events (turn/move steps, door toggled shut and reopened in u2, key re-pickup in u2, key_lost impossibilities in u0/u2), with listed events taking priority in valid orderings (door_open before key_lost in u1; they never co-occur by the stated constraints). (5) Reward safety: progress rewards are dense across the three milestones (0.1, 0.2, 1.0), bounded (max total 1.3), with zero on all self-loops, preventing idle or toggle farming. (6) Reachability and compactness: all four states are reachable via feasible event sequences (including the seed-1 key_lost reset variant), and 4 states with u0 reused as the reset target is minimal. (7) Format matches the paper header exactly (STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES/TRANSITION_FUNCTION/REWARD_FUNCTION with else self-loops). Minor non-blocking note: in u2, a door re-shut followed by key re-pickup is treated as retained progress (door_open as else), consistent with the published RM's reading that the open-after-key obligation discharges at the first opening and with task-rm-pairs.md:15; acceptance remains gated on actual goal contact, so only goal-reaching traces are rewarded.
